name: Change the notary table (ticker.cash v27)
description: Rotates a v27 oracle to a new notary table. A strict majority of the current rows each sign one approval; the transaction carries them and the covenant verifies them. Rows that do not take part are absent.

resources.name: ticker.cash governance
resources.description: Rotation, migration and retirement by majority approval.

operator.name: Operator
operator.description: Proposes the new table, collects approvals and posts the rotation. Holds no power: without a majority nothing moves.

headCommitment.description: The current head's 37-byte commitment: state (17) ‖ hash160(current table) (20).

headValue.name: Head value
headValue.description: Satoshis held by the head (the reserve).

rotationFee.name: Fee
rotationFee.description: Satoshis the reserve pays for this transaction: its size plus one. The covenant caps it at 1,000 + 2 × the unlocking data length.

oldTable.name: Current table
oldTable.description: The current table, n × (compressed pubkey 33 ‖ exchange id 1), hex. Must hash to the head's table hash.

newTable.name: New table
newTable.description: The proposed table, same layout, hex. Its hash160 becomes the head's new table hash.
